items.coverage: no conversion: Rust starts on Go's stopped state unchanged; its answers equal Go's own restart on a copy, and the snapshot's checksums are unchanged (M5 cross-read, M12a)
items.name: state conversion

items.coverage: stop Go with a task in flight, snapshot with checksums, start Rust on a copy, query over MCP, restart, query again: equal to Go's restart and to the Go control; exact agent ID kept
items.name: forward rehearsal

items.coverage: Go starts on the copy Rust wrote and reports every task, Rust-era work included, with the status and message Rust last reported; the Go control matches
items.name: rollback rehearsal

items.coverage: SIGINT with a call mid-shim: both agents stop accepting, finish the call (200, Connection: close) and exit 0
items.name: in-flight drill: synchronous call

items.coverage: SIGINT with an admitted task mid-shim: both persist it cancelled ("The Host Agent shut down before the task completed."), wait for the shim and exit 0; a restart reports it cancelled
items.name: in-flight drill: admitted task

items.coverage: SIGINT with a task still in resource binding: both drain the same way; after a restart Go reports it cancelled and Rust does not know it, the declared D12 difference
items.name: in-flight drill: task in binding

items.coverage: Go takes no state-directory lock: on both sides the second agent starts and serves, neither sees the other's in-memory tasks, and a restart sees both agents' tasks
items.name: two agents on one state directory

items.coverage: 15 minutes, Go and Rust twins from one golden under one seeded mixed workload with SIGTERM and SIGKILL restarts: outcome classes equal per iteration, latency and growth within thresholds declared from a Go/Go shakedown, no more journal errors, final durable state equal after the declared masks (evidence/m12b)
items.name: soak

items.name: state-directory writer lock
